description: Points one subdomain of the customer's domain at Gavvio (a Cloudflare for SaaS custom hostname), used for first-party event tracking (e.g. events.<brand>) and branded short links (e.g. go.<brand>). DNS only; never applied at the zone apex.
variableDescription: No variables. Apply with host=<the chosen subdomain> (e.g. events, go); the template refuses the zone apex.
